Accumulative Stats: Both of the Card's current Attack and Health Stats combined.
Adaptation: You can activate this Ability once to then select one of the listed Abilities to be activated.
AL Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is in the AL.
Alternative Condition:
Another Condition that can be met instead of the primary Condition.
That could potentially have an Alternate Ability.
Asleep:
Countdown Counters are applied for and taken off for the Turns.
While Asleep Phantoms are unable to Initiate an Attack, Deal Battle Damage, or Activate an Ability.
Sleep is no longer Applied after the Countdown Ends or if the Asleep Phantom takes Damage.
If a Phantom has both Tired and Sleep Applied to them, then Tired will always Apply first and Sleep will be applied after Tired has ended.
Attack Burn: When this card successfully Initiates Battle – its current Attack is dealt to the enemy Player.
Attack Suppression: A Phantom that has had it's Attack Suppressed cannot Initiate an Attack this turn.
Balance Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is on the field in the Balance Slot. This overwrites a Field Ability.
Balance Summon: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is Summoned to a Balance Slot. This overwrites a Field Summon.
Banish: Send the card to the Shadow Realm.
Battle Flip: Activate the attaching Ability when this Phantom Flips up to Initiate Battle.
Battle Position: A Phantom's current Position. Being either Attack or Defense Position.
Berserker: Gain an additional Attack after breaking a Phantom in Battle.
Bleed:
Add a Bleed Counter to a Phantom.

Apply the following Condition to the Phantom at Turn End based on the number of Bleed Counters on it:

1: Take 100 Damage.
2: Take 300 Damage.
3: Take 600 Damage.
4: Take 1000 Damage.
5: Take 1500 Damage.
6+: Take 2000 Damage.
Blocker: This card can Activate it’s Blocker Ability when an enemy initiates an Attack. This card can redirect that attack to itself. Blocker can only be activated once per turn.
Bounce Out: Once per Turn: Bounce this card and Special Summon a Phantom of equal or less SP and that meets the listed requirements.
Bouncer: After Battle calculations, the card that Battled this card is Bounced back to hand.
Break:
Send the card to the After Life.
A Phantom Breaks if it runs out of Health.
Break Impowering: The listed ability is activated after this card Breaks.
Breaker: When this card Battles another card, after the Battle resolves, that card has a Break applied to it.
Breaks: Send the card to the After Life.
Burn:
Burn deals the listed Damage at each Turn End.
While a Phantom has Burn Applied to them, it loses 100 Attack multiplied by their Original Level.
Until the Burn is Cured or while it is Negated.
Burner: This Phantom Applies Burn to any Phantom it Damages, equal to the Attaching number.
Charm:
Add a Charm Counter to a Phantom.
While a Phantom has any Charm Counters they have Charm and Charmed Applied to them.
A Phantom loses a Charm Counter at the end of each Turn.
Apply the following Abilities based on the number of Charm Counters on this Phantom.

1: Cannot Initiate an Attack.
2: Cannot Deal Battle Damage.
3: The Player who does not control this card, on their turn, can have this Phantom Initiate an Attack and choose the Target.


If this Status Effect is Cured or Negated remove all Charm Counters.
Charmer:
This card can Spend its Attack to Targeted Charm a Card.
Add a Charm Counter the Phantom.
While a Phantom has any Charm Counters they have Charm and Charmed Applied to them.
A Phantom loses a Charm Counter at the end of each Turn.
Apply the following Abilities based on the number of Charm Counters on this Phantom.


1: Cannot Initiate an Attack.
2: Cannot Deal Battle Damage.
3: The Player who does not control this card, on their turn, can have this Phantom Initiate an Attack and choose the Target.


If this Status Effect is Cured or Negated remove all Charm Counters.
Condition: The listed Condition is what must be done to activate the card.
Coordinating Attacker:
When activating you can select Ally Phantoms (in addition to this Phantom) that share this keyword who will expend their Attack this turn.
The activating Phantom automatically Initializes an Attack.
Target an Enemy Phantom to Attack.
This Phantom’s Attack is equal to the combined total of all selected Phantoms.
The Activating Phantom takes regular Battle Damage.
The other Selected Phantoms take half damage, rounded down (from 50).
Copy: Create a Copy of the card with its current Stats, Abilities, and other conditions.
Count Down:
Start with the listed number of Turn Counters. One is Removed at the end of each turn.

When all Counters are removed then either:

The Continuous card Ability will stop and the card is sent to the AL.
Or the listed Ability will be activated.
Create: Add into play another specified card. (Not from any deck or hand but from outside the game. Similar to a token).
Cursed: The card will have an Ability applied to it at a later point or after a Condition is met.
Cycle: Hand Ability: Draw another card and then place this card randomly back into the deck.
Damage Empowering: The attaching Ability is activated after this card takes Damage.
Deathbane:
When Deathbane is applied to a Phantom give it a Deathbane Counter.

Apply the following Abilities based on the number of Deathbane Counters on the Phantom.

1: This Phantom cannot Gain or Heal Health.
2: This Phantom is Discarded at Turn End.
Defeat Impowering: When this Phantom is Defeated in Battle activate the attaching Ability.
Delayed Attack: When this card Battles, the Enemy Phantom Deals their Battle Damage first, before Battle Calculations.
Destructive: When this card Targets another card and that action results in that card Breaking, it is Destroyed instead.
Destructive Surge: You can activate this Ability from your hand or field, to Destroy this card and then Activate the attaching Ability.
Direct Attacker: This card can Attack Directly even while your opponent has Phantoms on the field.
Discard: Send the card to the After Life.
Discard Impowering: When this card is Discarded the attached Ability can be activated.
Discarded: Send the card to the After Life.
Discarding Surge: You can activate this Ability from your hand or field, to Discard this card and then Activate the attaching Ability.
Dodge: When a Game Action (Ability, Attack, Battle) goes off but is avoided by the card.
Dodge Roll: Can be activated in response to a Game Action (Ability or Attack) that would effect this card or its current Card Slot. This card must move to an available adjacent card Slot for this Ability to be activated. Dodge the Game Action.
Dodger: Can be activated in response to a game Action (Ability or Attack) that would either Target, Break, or effect this card –– and that activated action is avoided.
Draw Step: The part of the Draw Phase where you Draw for free.
Enduring: The first time when this Phantom Battles with another Phantom -- that would result in both Phantoms Breaking, this Phantom does not Break.
Environment Range:
The Environment Range determines what Players and cards are effected by the Environment's ability and if they can use Activate the Environment's Ability.

When only one Player has an Environment in play, both Fields and Players are in the Environment Range.

When both players have an Environment in play, only their side of the field is in their own Environment Range.
Equip Card: This card is attached to the selected card and placed in a Support Card Slot. It's ability is applied to the Equipped card until this card leaves the field. If the Equipped Card leaves the field then this card is Discarded.
Equipped: This Ability is applied to the card equipped to by this card.
Evolution:
You can Activate this Ability by spending the listed Evolve Cost and then Unsummoning this Phantom card.
Special Summon the listed Phantom.
Spending the gained SP from the Unsummon to do so.
Evolve: The cost of Activating this card's Evolution Ability.
Excavate:
Look at a certain number of cards from the top of your deck.
Usually to Draw a chosen card.
Fell: Send a card to the Bottom of the Player’s Main Deck.
Field Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is on the field.
Field Summon: This Ability can only be activated when the card is Summoned to a Field Slot.
First Strike:
When this card Initiates Battle, it deals its Attack as Damage to the Battling Phantom before Battle Calculations.
If it successfully does so then this card deals 0 Damage during Battle Calculations.
Flip: Activate the attaching Ability when the card Flips up from being face down.
Flying:
This card can Attack the Opponent Directly, even while they're Enemy Phantoms on the Field.
Except if there is an Enemy Phantom with Flying.
Fragile: After this card Battles, it has a Break applied to it.
Freeze:
Phantoms that have Freeze Applied to them are Frozen.
Frozen Phantoms cannot Initiate an Attack.
While a Phantom has Frozen Applied to them, it takes an additional 100 Damage in Battle multiplied by their Original level.
Freezer: This Phantom Applies Freeze to any Phantom it Battles, for the number of Attaching Turns.
Frozen:
Frozen Phantoms cannot Initiate an Attack.
While a Phantom has Frozen Applied to them, it takes an additional 100 Damage in Battle multiplied by their Original level.
Fusion Search:
Hand Ability: Search a Fusion Spirit that shares an Archetype with this Card.
Then add this Phantom to the Extra Deck.
Hand Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is in the hand.
Held: A card that is currently in hand.
Instant Play: Instantly activate the card's Ability when the attaching Condition is met.
Manic:
This Phantom must Attack every turn.
If it does not Attack then it has a Break Applied to it.
Marked:
The Attaching Ability or condition is being applied to a card.
It stays applied even after the card leaves the field / its current position.
Max Regeneration: At the end of the turn fully Heal the Phantom.
Negate: Stop a game action from happening. Such as stopping an Ability from Activating.
Oblivion Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is in Oblivion.
On Summon: The attaching Ability happens when the card is Summoned.
Own: A card in a player's control currently within their hand or field.
Owned: A card in a player's control currently within their hand or field.
Paralysis:
A Phantom with Paralysis applied to it cannot Attack or Deal Battle Damage.
Paralysis is Applied for the listed number of Turns.
Parlizer: This Phantom Applies Paralysis to any Phantom it Battles, for the listed number of Turns.
Piercing: Deal Summoner Battle Damage through Defense Position Phantoms.
Poison:
Poison deals the listed Damage at each Turn End.
Poison also deals the listed Damage every time the Phantom takes an Action.
Until the Poison is Cured or while it is Negated.
Poisonous: This Phantom Applies Poison to any Phantom it Damages, equal to the Attaching number.
Possess: Have a card of the listed type in your Hand, or on your Field, or inside of one of your Removal Piles.
Prime: Place a card onto the top of the owner's Main Deck.
Quick: The Attaching Ability is one Speed faster than normal.
Ranged: When this card Initiates Battle, it deals the listed Damage to the Battling Phantom before Battle Initializes.
Recast: If you successfully use this card’s Ability, you can pay the attaching cost to add it back to your hand.
Redirect: Choose a new target for the Game Action (Ability/Attack).
Regeneration: At the end of the Turn Heal damage equal to the listed number.
Reincarnate: Select a Phantom from your After Life to add to your hand.
Resurrect: Summon a Phantom from the After Life. For it's SP Cost.
Rush: This Phantom does not have to wait a turn to initiate a Direct Attack.
Seal:
The card is locked into the location that it is Sealed in.
It cannot be taken out of that location or otherwise interacted with -- without specifically an Ability that interacts with Sealed cards.
Sealed:
The card is locked into the location that it is Sealed in.
It cannot be taken out of that location or otherwise interacted with -- without specifically an Ability that interacts with Sealed cards.
Search: Find a card from the designated deck to add to select. Most often drawing a card from the main deck.
Shadow Realm Ability: This Ability can only be activated while this Card is in the Shadow Realm.
Shadow Step:
If this card is Targeted, you can Banish this card and Dodge.

At the Start of the next turn, Unbanish this card.
All damage and conditions on this card are still applied to it.

Once per card summon.
Shielded:
The first damage this card would take is negated.
This only applied once per Shielded application. Often meaning once per summon.
Slash: When this Phantom Initiates Battle – Deal the listed Damage to any Phantoms on both sides of the Defending Phantom.
Sleep:
When a Phantom has Sleep Applied to them are Asleep, for the listed number of Turns.
Countdown Counters are applied for and taken off for the Turns.
While Asleep Phantoms are unable to Initiate an Attack, Deal Battle Damage, or Activate an Ability.
Sleep is no longer Applied after the Countdown Ends or if the Asleep Phantom takes Damage.
If a Phantom has both Tired and Sleep Applied to them, then Tired will always Apply first and Sleep will be applied after Tired has ended.
Slow: This Ability is one Speed slower than normal.
Slow Start: This Phantom is unable to Attack the turn it is Summoned.
Special Swap:
This keyword acts as a Swap while in hand. This Keyword acts like Swap while on the field.

But gains an Additional Field Ability:

Select a Phantom that meets the listed requirements from your Hand or Extra Deck. Place this Activating Phantom where the Selected Phantom is and then Special Summon that Phantom.
Spin: Shuffle a card randomly into the Player’s Main Deck.
Stat Swap: Swap the current Attack and Health of a Phantom.
Static:
Phantoms that have Static Applied to them have Delayed Attack.
The Enemy Phantom Deals their Attack Damage first in Battle.
Static Shocker: This Phantom Applies Static to any Phantom it Damages.
Stats: Both the Attack and Health of a Phantom.
Status Effect:
Various Keywords that are Applied to Phantoms with varying Abilities.
Including: Burn, Poison, Static, Paralysis, Freeze (Frozen), Tired, Sleep (Asleep).
Stealth:
This card cannot be Targeted by the opponent until it Activates an Ability or declares an Attack.
Reveal negates Stealth.
Sturdy:
The first time this Phantom would Break, that Break is Negated.
If this happens as a result of the Phantom losing all its Health, it stays on zero health and the Zero Health Rules apply.
Summon Binding: This card cannot be Unsummoned by the Player.
Summoner Battle Damage: The Player takes Summoner Damage in Battle for all excess Attack beyond their Phantom's Health.
Summoner Damage: Any damage that is applied to the Summoner as a result of Attacks or Battle.
Suppress:
A card that has been Suppressed has its Abilities turned off for the turn.
If it's Ability is already Activated and on the Line -- that Ability will still happen.
Swap:
Hand Ability: Select a Phantom that meets the listed requirements from your Extra Deck. Swap the two Phantoms.

Field Ability:
Select an Ally Phantom that meets the requirements. Swap their Field Slot positions.
Attacks Declared towards a swapped Phantom are aimed at the Phantom now in its place.
Swift Strike:
This Ability activates whenever this Phantom Battles. Deal this Phantom's Attack to the Battling Phantom prior to Battle Initializing.
If the other Phantom survives then Battle progresses as normal.
Switch Out: Once per Turn: Add this card back to hand and Special Summon a Phantom of equal or less SP and that meets the listed requirements.
Target: This card Targets a Card for the ability to be applied to.
Targeted: This card Targets a Card for the ability to be applied to.
Targeted Dodge Roll: Can be activated in response to this card or it’s Card Slot being Targeted. This card must move to an available adjacent card Slot for this Ability to be activated. Dodge the Targeted Action.
Targeted Reveal: Target a card on the field to Reveal.
Taunter:
Other Phantoms on the field without Taunter cannot be Targeted for an Attack while this card is Face up on the field.
If there is an Attaching condition that condition must be met.
Threat:
The Counter can only be turned up at the start of the turn to become active.

Its Condition being met has the card's Ability automatically go off.

If its Condition is not met by the end of the turn it was activated this card is sent to the AL.
Timer:
Add a Counter to this card based on the attaching Ability at the end of each turn.
Such as adding 1 Turn Counter at the end of each turn.
Tired:
While Tired Phantoms are unable to Initiate an Attack.
Tired is no longer Applied after the Countdown Ends or if the Tired Phantom takes Damage.
If a Phantom has both Tired and Sleep Applied to them, then Tired will always Apply first and Sleep will be applied after Tired has ended.
Token:
A card treated as a Phantom.
If details are not given for a token, it is to be treated as a Level 0 Phantom without an Ability, 0-Stats, and no Archetype.
Transformation: Unsummon this card to Special Summon the listed Phantom.
Unsummon:
On your turn, send your own Ally Phantom to the A: and gain the Summoning Points of that card's current Field SP/Level back.
You cannot Unsummon a card the turn it has Battled.
Victory Impowering: When this Phantom Defeats another Phantom in Battle, activate the attaching Ability.
